errors.text_span: Die linke Grafik ist ein gestapeltes Balkendiagramm
errors.evidence: The left panel is not a stacked bar chart; the bars for Bund, Länder, and Gemeinden are grouped side-by-side within each year, not stacked on top of each other.

errors.text_span: wobei die Höhe jedes Balkens die Summe der Investitionen aller drei Kategorien für das jeweilige Jahr darstellt
errors.evidence: Because the bars are grouped rather than stacked, no single bar height represents the sum of the three categories; the black line shows the total series separately.

errors.text_span: Die rechte Grafik ist eine Linienkarte
errors.evidence: The right panel is better described as a line chart or line graph, not a 'Linienkarte'.

errors.text_span: Die schwarze Linie repräsentiert „Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt“, deren Wert durch die Summe der Investitionen aller drei Körperschaften ermittelt wird.
errors.evidence: The black line represents total investments of 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt', but it is not visually shown as being computed from the displayed bars; the description incorrectly presents this calculation as a visible chart feature.

errors.text_span: Auch hier ist das Jahr 2000 mit einer gestrichelten Linie und der Beschriftung „Bahnreform“ markiert.
errors.evidence: The year 2000 is marked by a dashed vertical line, but the label 'Bahnreform' is placed with an arrow pointing to the line rather than simply being a direct mark.

The response does not explicitly distinguish that the two panels show different measures: gross fixed investment on the left and net fixed investment on the right, which is an important purpose/detail highlighted in the reference.
